env.STRATA_DRAFT_UFAC: <u1,u2,...,u16 from the box trace: u_m = sum of the first m values of draft_costs.py new_misses_per_row>

note: STRATA_DRAFT_UFAC (MOD_PLAN section 6 item 47, LEADS.md Expert-union draft-length cost): prices a window width the policy has not measured yet by cost(t) = a + b t + c u(t) fitted over the measured widths, where u(m) is the mean distinct CPU experts per forward of m positions (u_m = cumulative sum of tools/pancake/trace/draft_costs.py new_misses_per_row over rows 0..m-1, from a STRATA_WINDOW_TRACE box run). SKELETON: the arm value is a placeholder until that table exists (a value that is not 2..16 positive numbers prints a line and runs as base). Exact output: it only prices window sizes. Expect noise: measured widths are never touched, so it matters only while a width is new.
